opportunities.name: Internet Society Fellowship 2027
opportunities.coverage: Mentorship, travel support for a relevant Internet event, and a potential project stipend up to US$5,000. Exact travel arrangements follow programme terms.
opportunities.eligibility: Complete prerequisite training and propose a practical project in Internet policy, connectivity or safety. Global applicants; competitive selection.
steps: Enroll in free pre-fellowship training by November 22, 2026.
Complete the required modules and develop a feasible community project.
Use the application link sent after completing training.
Apply by December 18, 2026; selection is competitive.

opportunities.name: PostgreSQL Europe travel scholarships
opportunities.coverage: Approved expenses reimbursed after the event against receipts. The committee sets a maximum award; upfront travel money may be needed.
opportunities.eligibility: People facing financial or systemic barriers. Demonstrate a benefit to the PostgreSQL community; nearby events are favoured.
steps: Choose a relevant upcoming PostgreSQL Europe event.
Email diversity@postgresql.eu yourself with your request and budget.
Ask about eligibility, timing and the amount before booking.
